entries.name: NativeScript
entries.definition: An open-source framework for building native iOS and Android apps from a single JavaScript or TypeScript code base.

entries.name: Natural capital
entries.definition: The world's stock of natural assets, such as land, water, air and living things, that provides goods and services to people.

entries.name: Natural gas pipelines
entries.definition: The pipeline systems that transport natural gas, and the engineering, operation and regulation of them.

entries.name: Natural language generation
entries.definition: The part of natural language processing concerned with having software produce readable human language from data or meaning.

entries.name: Natural language processing
entries.definition: Computational analysis and generation of human language.

entries.name: Natural language processing systems
entries.definition: Software systems that analyse or produce human language, such as translators, chatbots and text classifiers.

entries.name: Natural language understanding
entries.definition: The part of natural language processing concerned with getting machines to grasp the meaning and intent of human language.

entries.name: Nautical charts
entries.definition: Maps made for marine navigation that show water depths, coastlines, hazards and aids to navigation.

entries.name: Navigational aid
entries.definition: A device, marker or system, such as a buoy, beacon or radio transmitter, that helps ships or aircraft find their position and route.

entries.name: Navisworks
entries.definition: Autodesk software that combines design and construction models of a building project so they can be reviewed and checked for clashes.

entries.name: NedGraphics
entries.definition: Computer-aided design software for textile and fashion design, such as print, weave and knit design.

entries.name: Needle localization
entries.definition: Marking the location of a lesion, usually in the breast, by placing a needle or wire under imaging guidance so a surgeon can find and remove it.

entries.name: Neonatal intensive care nursing
entries.definition: Nursing care for critically ill or premature newborns in a neonatal intensive care unit.

entries.name: .NET development
entries.definition: Building software applications on Microsoft's .NET platform, using languages such as C#.

entries.name: Net Promoter Score
entries.definition: A customer loyalty metric based on how likely customers are to recommend a company, scored from -100 to 100.

entries.name: Net zero
entries.definition: A state in which the greenhouse gases a person, company or country puts into the atmosphere are balanced by those removed.

entries.name: Nette
entries.definition: An open-source PHP framework for building web applications.

entries.name: Network intrusion detection system
entries.definition: A tool that monitors network traffic for signs of attacks or policy violations and raises alerts.

entries.name: Network peering
entries.definition: An arrangement in which two networks connect directly to exchange traffic between their own customers, usually without paying each other for transit.

entries.name: Network performance
entries.definition: How fast, reliable and responsive a network is, judged by measures such as latency, throughput and packet loss.

entries.name: Network topology
entries.definition: The arrangement of the nodes and links in a network, such as bus, star, ring and mesh.

entries.name: Neural networks
entries.definition: Designing and reasoning about networks of learned computational units.

entries.name: Neurobiology
entries.definition: The branch of biology that studies the nervous system and how it develops and works.

entries.name: Neuromuscular medicine
entries.definition: The medical subspecialty that diagnoses and treats diseases of the nerves, the muscles and the junctions between them.

entries.name: Neuromuscular system and disorders
entries.definition: How the nerves and muscles work together and the diseases that disrupt them.

entries.name: Neurosurgery
entries.definition: The surgical specialty that treats disorders of the brain, spinal cord and peripheral nerves.

entries.name: Nexpose
entries.definition: Rapid7's vulnerability scanner, which finds and ranks security weaknesses in networks and systems.

entries.name: Next.js
entries.definition: A React-based framework for building server-rendered and static web applications.

entries.name: NFPA 70E
entries.definition: A National Fire Protection Association standard for electrical safety in the workplace in the United States.

entries.name: ngAnimate
entries.definition: An AngularJS module that lets CSS transitions, CSS animations or JavaScript run when page elements enter, leave or move.

entries.name: nice (Unix utility)
entries.definition: A Unix command that runs a program with a changed scheduling priority.

entries.name: NICE Workforce Management
entries.definition: Workforce management software from NICE for forecasting workload and scheduling staff in contact centres.

entries.name: Nightwatch.js
entries.definition: An end-to-end testing framework for web applications that runs on Node.js and drives browsers through WebDriver.

entries.name: NIH Stroke Scale
entries.definition: A standardised neurological examination scale that measures the severity of stroke symptoms.

entries.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
entries.definition: A voluntary framework from NIST that organises cybersecurity activities into functions such as identify, protect, detect, respond and recover.

entries.name: NIST SP 800-37
entries.definition: A NIST Special Publication that describes the Risk Management Framework for managing security and privacy risk in information systems.

entries.name: NIST SP 800-53
entries.definition: A NIST Special Publication that catalogues security and privacy controls for information systems and organisations.

entries.name: NIST SP 800 series
entries.definition: NIST's 800 series of Special Publications, which give guidelines and recommendations on information security.

entries.name: Nitrogen-phosphorus detector
entries.definition: A gas chromatography detector that responds selectively to compounds containing nitrogen or phosphorus.

entries.name: NLog
entries.definition: An open-source logging library for .NET applications.
